description:
The image depicts a blue frisbee with a logo on it, situated on top of a white envelope. The frisbee features a black logo in the center, surrounded by various objects, including a bicycle, a bird, a hammer, a square, and a flag. The logo itself is a stylized map of an island, accompanied by the text "The Open Planning Project" and "topp.openplans.org".
